thread:
alec: Quick flag  onboarding Sableon-13B (int8). fast perf but seeing weird token drop + occasional duplication anchored to invisible ZWJ (U+200D) boundaries in long-doc QA. suspect tokenizer vs rotary index misalignment.

priya: Can you drop the minimal repro and numbers?

alec: Ran smoke bench: 
```
./scripts/eval_onboard.sh --model sableon-13b --dtype int8 --prompts longform_2k.txt --max-tokens 2048 --batch 3 --seed 13
```
metrics fp16 -> int8:
- EM: 80.9 -> 75.3
- Rouge-L: 46.0 -> 41.2
- p95 latency: 300ms -> 95ms
- observed: token deletion after ZWJ-joined emoji and duplicated article "a a" after soft-breaks at ~600 tokens

mike: Which tokenizer conversion path? We had ZWJ folding differences between hf-converter v2/v4. Also check if your tokenmap preserves zero-width joins as separate tokens or collapses.

alec: Used hf-converter v4 (new folding). quick tokenmap-diff around the reported boundary: 
```
fp16 tokens: [.., 1203: "‍", 1204: "🏳️‍🌈", 1205: "\n"] (len 12)
int8 tokens: [.., 1203: "🏳️‍🌈", 1204: "\n"] (len 11)  # ZWJ merged into combined emoji
```
So sequence length changed which shifts downstream position ids.

priya: That explains it: rotary tables are position-based; if token positions shift middoc, later positions use different sin/cos entries and small quantization error accumulates. Also int8 kernel autotune chooses a freq_scale < 1 sometimes. Pull runtime rotary/meta and int8 kernel params.

alec: runtime dump:
```
rotary: {base: 10000, head_dim: 64, per_head_scale: true}
fp16_kernel: freq_scale=1.0, interp=none
int8_kernel: freq_scale=0.987 (autotune), interp=kbit-linterp
```
That matches suspicion.

mike: Two fast checks: 1) re-run int8 forcing freq_scale=1.0 and interp=none to see if quality recovers; 2) run tokenizer conversion with ZWJ-preserve flag (hf-converter v4 --preserve-zwj) so token counts match fp16.

alec: Did both. Results:
- int8 with freq_scale=1.0 & interp=none: EM 77.1 (partial recovery), duplication reduced but still some missing proper nouns.
- int8 with tokenmap preserved ZWJ (no freq override): EM 78.3, less duplication.
- both fixes together: EM 79.8 (close to fp16 80.9) and echo/dup pattern mostly gone in sampled set.

priya: Sounds like mixed root cause: tokenizer merge + kernel autotune. Action items:
1) add tokenmap-diff check to onboarding (compare token counts on 200 canonical long docs).
2) add runtime flag to pin rotary_freq_scale and interp for canary quant kernels.
3) consider a short per-head re-calibration for int8 if residuals remain.

mike: I'll open PR to add --preserve-zwj option to converter docs and a CI job. PR-4682.

alec: I'll collect failing prompts and logits diffs and upload to /shared/onboard/sableon/zwj_analysis.

ops-bot: deploy:quant-kernels/2026-03-30 08:45 UTC -> Canary queued (3 GPUs) pending PR merge.

triage-bot: ONB-2026-117 created: "Sableon int8 ZWJ/tokenizer-rotary misalignment" (severity: info).

priya: Once PR lands, do a 1k blind A/B (mixed long/short). If still non-trivial gap, schedule per-head calibration with stratified long-context corpus.

alec: Will follow up here with AB results. Thanks all :thumbsup:
